mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies today with a temperature of 61 degrees, feeling like 53. If you look up tonight at 5:47 PM, you can catch the ISS rising over Cross Plains and traveling toward Madison near Home Depot.

The City of Verona has announced a massive infrastructure project for 2027 and 2028, focusing on replacing 1950s-era water and sewer lines on streets including North Shuman and North Marietta. A public information meeting is set for December 16 to discuss the plans.

We have plenty to do this week. Yoga at Insight Wellness is taking place today, and ART House 360 is hosting happy hours and events tonight. Tomorrow, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard.
On November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where they found an unresponsive driver who was later arrested for O W I.
If you are craving something sweet, head over to Culver's today to try their Double Strawberry flavor of the day. They are open until 10 PM this evening.
